## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a capable, highly observant, and inquisitive woman who keeps a sharp eye on everything around her, resting only after uncovering the reason behind anything odd. Known for being an active church worker, she considers herself a shrewd judge of human nature and is regarded as very farseeing. Though kindly at heart, she can be officious, critical, and outspoken, holding strong opinions that include a firm disbelief in higher education for women and strict religious views condemning play-acting. She takes great pleasure in sewing and dearly loves to be asked for advice.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde raised ten children and buried two, and earned local renown for knitting sixteen cotton warp quilts. After spotting [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and strongly warned [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) against their plan to adopt an orphan boy. Upon meeting the adopted girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Mrs. Lynde offended her with blunt remarks about her hair, prompting an outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md); however, Mrs. Lynde later accepted Anne's dramatic apology and forgave her. Mrs.

## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

> "I don’t know it. I guess you’re going to teach right here in Avonlea. The trustees have decided to give you the school."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Although initially designated as an enemy due to hostility over blunt remarks about Anne's red hair and appearance, Mrs. Lynde's dynamic with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly softens into forgiveness. When Mrs. Lynde first met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), her insults provoked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into a fiery rage, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to confine the girl to her room. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a dramatic apology, Mrs. Lynde completely forgave her and gifted her flowers. Mrs. Lynde subsequently acts as a source of counsel regarding the young girl, offering [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) advice on how to handle Anne's decision to stay home from school, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later seeks Mrs. Lynde's guidance on how to fix her predicament with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), +13 more_

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are longstanding neighbors and friends despite their personal differences. Mrs. Lynde frequently drops by [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), such as when she investigated Matthew's unusual trip and warned [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) against adopting an orphan, or when she visited to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) also turns to Mrs. Lynde for guidance, accepting her advice on letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) study at home when she refuses to attend school.
